title: Concentrated Causal Influence, Distributed Diagnostic Information: Cognitive Impairment Decisions in Large Audio-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.32061v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) can assess cognitive impairment (CI) from speech, yet their answers reveal neither which internal components control the decision nor how much CI information is accessible in their representations. We investigate both questions through CI-contrast neurons (CICNs), selected by class-contrastive activation frequency in decoder MLPs. Across eight open LALMs and two corpora (Pitt and PROCESS-2), we causally test CICNs against size- and layer-matched random masks and activity-matched controls. In three of the five models that meet our eligibility criteria, ablation of small CICN sets causes large, class-directed prediction shifts; speech-identified masks also control transcript-only decisions, and three of four primary Pitt masks retain specificity on PROCESS-2. translated_title: 集中的因果影响，分布式的诊断信息：大型音频-语言模型中的认知障碍决策
translated_abstract: 大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）能够从语音中评估认知障碍（CI），但其回答既无法揭示哪些内部组件控制着这一决策，也无法揭示其表征中蕴含多少可获取的认知障碍信息。我们通过认知障碍对比神经元（CICNs）来研究这两个问题，这类神经元是通过解码器MLP中的类对比激活频率筛选得到的。在八个开源LALMs和两个语料库（Pitt与PROCESS-2）上，我们将CICNs与大小和层匹配的随机掩码以及激活匹配的对照组进行因果测试。在符合资格标准的五个模型中，有三个模型的少量CICNs被消融后会引起大幅的、面向特定类别的预测偏移；从语音中识别出的掩码也能控制仅基于转写文本的决策，且四个主要Pitt掩码中有三个在PROCESS-2上保持了特异性。位置受限的干预实验将这种影响定位在最终答案位置之前，并在语音或转写文本证据出现之后最为强烈。
tldr: 该论文通过因果干预识别出大型音频-语言模型解码器MLP中的“认知障碍对比神经元”（CICNs），首次从因果层面证明认知障碍决策由少量神经元集中控制，而诊断信息以分布式形式存在于模型表征中，且这一机制在不同模型间和跨语料库上具有一定泛化性。
en_tdlr: This paper causally identifies CI-contrast neurons (CICNs) in the decoder MLPs of large audio-language models, demonstrating that cognitive impairment decisions are controlled by a small concentrated set of neurons while diagnostic information is distributed across model representations, with partial generalization across models and corpora.
